capabilities: Build dashboard blocks (tasks, table, stat, chart, countdown, text) from a dialog instead of a query language
Filter, sort and group tasks and files using Tasks emoji shorthand or Dataview inline fields
Render hand-written SVG charts that inherit theme colours
Toggle task checkboxes with line verification before writing
Re-index edited notes reactively via Obsidian's metadataCache
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not clean or format notes; it renders read-only dashboard blocks from data already in the vault.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin browser; must be installed manually from GitHub releases. Benchmark figures are the author's own, measured in Node, not inside Obsidian. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later (older versions get release 0.1.7). Release assets include build provenance attestations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn existing tasks and note metadata into live dashboards without learning a query language or running JavaScript.

relations.evidence: It reads the task syntax you already use — both the Tasks plugin's emoji shorthand
and Dataview's inline fields — so it drops into an existing vault without rewriting anything

summary: Dashboard builder that renders task lists, tables, key figures, countdowns and hand-drawn SVG charts from existing notes via YAML blocks, fully local.
